【题材】：仙侠宫斗
【画风】：写实电影感
【时长】：30s
【角色档案】：
角色A
角色B
【分镜脚本】（共9个镜头，按从左到右、从上到下顺序）：

subtitle, subtitles, text, caption, word, letter, font, hardcoded subtitles, lower thirds, overlay text, timestamp:1.4), (watermark, logo, word, signature, copyright, credit:1.3), blurry, oversaturated, pixelated, low resolution, grainy, distorted, noise, compression artifacts, jpeg artifacts, glitches, bad anatomy, deformed limbs, extra fingers, mutated hands, distorted sound, saturated sound, loud

[0.00-5.50] Slow majestic push-in, low-angle establishing shot, a regal empress in jade-green and gold embroidered Hanfu stands center surrounded by six elegant palace maidens in a misty ancient hall, soft serene expression with subtle proud poise, eyes calm and commanding, gentle facial muscles relaxed, volumetric mist drifting, golden lantern glow, cinematic 8K detail, ethereal atmosphere, Subtitle: "今夜，月色正好，沐浴更衣。"

[5.50-11.00] Slow dolly-in to close-up, the empress's face fills the frame framed by ornate golden phoenix headdress, faint knowing smile fading into solemn dignity, eyes shimmering with intelligence and quiet sorrow, realistic delicate facial movement, soft chiaroscuro lighting, swirling steam, jewel reflections sparkling, hyper-detailed skin texture, Subtitle: "她们都在等本宫的决定。"

[11.00-16.00] Wide tracking shot drifting across a steaming jade bathhouse, maidens kneeling around a circular hot spring with carved dragon stone, reverent lowered gazes, gentle contemplative expressions, faces softly lit, volumetric steam rising, warm lantern backlight, glistening water reflections, opulent cinematic depth, Subtitle: "玉池已备，娘娘请。"

[16.00-20.00] Medium handheld shot, two maidens seated by the water unrolling an ancient painted scroll, one resting chin on hand in pensive thought, focused intimate expressions with downcast eyes, realistic subtle face muscles, candlelight flickering on silk robes, soft golden glow, atmospheric mist, Subtitle: "这画中藏着先帝的秘密。"

[20.00-24.50] Close tracking shot, a maiden pouring water from a jade ladle into the steaming spring, the other watching intently, gentle serene yet curious expressions, eyes following the streaming water, delicate realistic features, cascading water droplets catching light, drifting vapor, luminous cinematic detail, Subtitle: "一滴一滴，洗去前尘往事。"

[24.50-29.50] Wide symmetrical shot, the empress seated among maidens lined along the misty spring, all gazing forward in solemn unity, dignified composed expressions, calm resolute eyes, subtle realistic facial detail, glowing lotus lanterns floating, golden warm light, ethereal steam, grand palace ambiance, Subtitle: "今夜过后，宫中将变天。"

[29.50-34.00] Macro overhead push-in, a carved jade orb floating among pink lotus blossoms on rippling water, ghostly silhouettes of maidens reflected in the misty background, dreamlike ethereal mood, delicate water ripples expanding, soft volumetric haze, pale moonlight glimmer, exquisite cinematic detail, Subtitle: "玉玺，终于现世。"

[34.00-42.00] Slow majestic crane-up, the empress and her maidens standing beneath a grand moonlit archway, full moon glowing behind ancient palace rooftops, regal solemn poise with composed proud expressions, calm determined eyes, realistic graceful faces, drifting night mist, ethereal blue moonlight backlight, golden lantern accents, breathtaking epic cinematic finale, Subtitle: "从今往后，这天下，由本宫执掌。"
